            (Heap_read hprev addr)
            (bIte (natLtB (Pointer.endAddr dst) addr) (Heap_read hprev addr) (Heap_read (Heap_write hprev daddr v) addr)) := rfl

                let h4 : natLtB addr (Pointer.base dst) = Bool.true := Or.elim haddr (fun h5 => h5) (fun _ => rfl)

            | Bool.true =>

                (fun heq =>
                  let h4 : natLtB (Pointer.endAddr dst) addr = Bool.true := Or.elim haddr (fun _ => rfl) (fun h5 => h5)

                  (fun h4 => Bool.noConfusion h4)
                  (fun h4 => Bool.noConfusion h4)

def RegistryState.register (r : RegistryState) : RegistryState × Nat :=
  (RegistryState.mk (Nat.succ r.nextId) (r.nextId :: r.active), r.nextId)

def RegistryState.release (r : RegistryState) (id : Nat) : RegistryState :=
  RegistryState.mk r.nextId (List.filter (fun x => Nat.decEq x id |> (fun d => match d with | Decidable.isTrue _ => false | Decidable.isFalse _ => true)) r.active)

theorem RegistryState_register_injective (r : RegistryState) :
  let (r', id) := RegistryState.register r
  List.mem id r'.active :=
  let p := RegistryState.register r
  match p with
  | Prod.mk r' id =>
    let h1 : r' = RegistryState.mk (Nat.succ r.nextId) (r.nextId :: r.active) := rfl
    let h2 : id = r.nextId := rfl
    let h3 : List.mem id r'.active :=
      Eq.recOn (motive := fun x => List.mem id x) h1
        (Eq.recOn (motive := fun x => List.mem x (r.nextId :: r.active)) h2
          (List.mem_cons_self r.nextId r.active))
    h3

theorem RegistryState_release_not_mem (r : RegistryState) (id : Nat) :

def FileSystem.read (fs : FileSystem) (path : String) : Option (List Byte) :=
  let rec find (l : List FileState) : Option (List Byte) :=
    match l with
    | [] => none
    | f :: fs' =>
      match String.decEq f.path path with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ => some f.content
      | Decidable.isFalse _ => find fs'
  find fs.files

    match l with
    | [] => []
    | f :: fs' =>
      match String.decEq f.path oldpath with
      | Decidable.isTrue _ =>
        FileState.mk newpath f.content :: fs'
      | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
        f :: renameAux fs'
  FileSystem.mk (renameAux fs.files)

theorem inverse_forward_identity (layer : LayerCore) (input : List (List Float)) :
  inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer input) = input :=
  List.recOn input
    (Eq.refl (inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer [])))
    (fun x xs ih =>
      let h1 : forwardInPlace layer (x :: xs) =
        forwardRow layer x :: forwardInPlace layer xs := rfl
      let h2 : inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer (x :: xs)) =
        inverseInPlace layer (forwardRow layer x :: forwardInPlace layer xs) := rfl
      let h3 : inverseInPlace layer (forwardRow layer x :: forwardInPlace layer xs) =
        inverseRow layer (forwardRow layer x) :: inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer xs) := rfl
      let h4 : inverseRow layer (forwardRow layer x) = x := rfl
      let h5 : inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer xs) = xs := ih
      let h6 : inverseRow layer (forwardRow layer x) :: inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer xs) =
        x :: xs :=
        Eq.trans (congrArg (fun y => y :: inverseInPlace layer (forwardInPlace layer xs)) h4)
          (congrArg (fun y => x :: y) h5)
      Eq.trans h2 (Eq.trans h3 h6))

noncomputable def forwardOnCore (core : Core) (batch : List (List Float)) :

    batch

noncomputable def inverseOnCore (core : Core) (batch : List (List Float)) :
  List (List Float) :=
  List.foldl
    (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc)
    batch

theorem forwardOnCore_shape (core : Core) (batch : List (List Float)) :
  List.length (forwardOnCore core batch) = List.length batch :=
  List.recOn core.layers
    (Eq.refl (List.length (List.foldl (fun acc layer => forwardInPlace layer acc) batch [])))
    (fun l ls ih =>
      let h1 : List.foldl (fun acc layer => forwardInPlace layer acc) batch (l :: ls) =
        List.foldl (fun acc layer => forwardInPlace layer acc) (forwardInPlace l batch) ls := rfl
      let h2 : List.length (forwardInPlace l batch) = List.length batch := forwardInPlace_shape l batch
      Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg List.length h1) (congrArg List.length (Eq.refl (List.foldl (fun acc layer => forwardInPlace layer acc) (forwardInPlace l batch) ls))))
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => List.length (List.foldl (fun acc layer => forwardInPlace layer acc) x ls)) h2) ih))

theorem inverseOnCore_shape (core : Core) (batch : List (List Float)) :
  List.length (inverseOnCore core batch) = List.length batch :=
  List.recOn (List.reverse core.layers)
    (Eq.refl (List.length (List.foldl (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc) batch [])))
    (fun l ls ih =>
      let h1 : List.foldl (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc) batch (l :: ls) =
        List.foldl (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc) (inverseInPlace l batch) ls := rfl
      let h2 : List.length (inverseInPlace l batch) = List.length batch := inverseInPlace_shape l batch
      Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg List.length h1) (congrArg List.length (Eq.refl (List.foldl (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc) (inverseInPlace l batch) ls))))
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => List.length (List.foldl (fun acc layer => inverseInPlace layer acc) x ls)) h2) ih))
